extracted.intended_audience: published creative writers considering NEA Literature (Creative Writing) Fellowships
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and program requirements for applying to the National Endowment for the Arts Literature Fellowships (creative writing) program, which awards $25,000 grants in prose (fiction and creative nonfiction) and poetry. Includes eligibility, program cycle, award purpose, and application timeline information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship amount
rubrics_metrics.description: The National Endowment for the Arts Literature Fellowships program offers $25,000 grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Award is a single $25,000 fellowship intended to support the recipient; no further scoring guidance provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible genres
rubrics_metrics.description: Grants are offered in prose (fiction and creative nonfiction) and poetry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program operates on a two-year cycle with fellowships in prose and poetry available in alternating years; in 2023 applications accepted in prose (fiction and creative nonfiction).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant eligibility — published creative writers
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellowships are for published creative writers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page explicitly states the program is for "published creative writers" but does not detail what counts as publication on this excerpt; applicants should consult full eligibility guidance for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intended use / program purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellowships enable recipients to set aside time for writing, research, travel, and general career advancement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This describes the program's goals and the intended ways fellows may use the award funds; applicants should align their proposed use with these purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application calendar / timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Key dates: Literature Fellowships: Prose — Application Deadline March 8, 2023; Earliest Announcement of Grant Award or Rejection December 2023; Earliest Start Date for NEA Period of Performance January 1, 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must meet the posted deadline and be aware of award announcement and start date windows; consult the program page for updated years and cycles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource for past recipients
rubrics_metrics.description: Link to learn more about past recipients in the Literary Arts Impact section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewing past recipients can inform applicants about the kinds of projects and career stages the program has supported; page suggests this as a resource but gives no scoring details here.
